title: Line sketch: Cosmic Menagerie
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A surreal cosmic scene centered on a cracked globe with glowing core. A black silhouette woman with flowing hair touches the globe while a black wolf with glowing eyes and zebra-striped legs leaps above it. In the foreground, a horse and dog stand together. The background features swirling nebulae, multiple floating bubbles containing miniature scenes, and a human skull near the top (derived from generated still #3977).
